Title: Users' Microsoft Teams contact cards don't fully display Out of office text

User impact: Users' Microsoft Teams contact cards don't fully display Out of office text.

More info: Selecting “See more” doesn’t display the full Out of office message. Users may hover over the message to see the full text in a tool tip.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Teams and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users' Microsoft Teams contact cards may not fully display Out of office text

User impact: Users' Microsoft Teams contact cards may not fully display Out of office text.

More info: Selecting “See more” may not display the full Out of office message. Users may hover over the message to see the full text in a tool tip.

Current status: We're reviewing the screenshots provided by a subset of affected users to gain clarity on the issue and determine the next steps to isolate the root cause.

Scope of impact: Any user attempting to view Out of office text on Microsoft Teams contact cards may be impacted.

Next update by: Monday, October 12, 2026, at 11:00 PM UTC

Title: Users' Microsoft Teams contact cards may not fully display Out of office text

User impact: Users' Microsoft Teams contact cards may not fully display Out of office text.

More info: Selecting “See more” may not display the full Out of office message. Users may hover over the message to see the full text in a tool tip.

Current status: We've identified that a recent service change to the Microsoft Teams contact cards introduced a code regression in which the user interface (UI) of the Out of office text contains an invalid value and is causing impact. We're deploying a fix to correct the value and remediate the impact. We'll provide a timeline for the completion of the deployment as one becomes available.

Scope of impact: Any user attempting to view Out of office text on Microsoft Teams contact cards may be impacted.

Root cause: A recent service change to the Microsoft Teams contact cards introduced a code regression in which the user interface (UI) of the Out of office text contains an invalid value and is causing impact.

Next update by: Monday, October 19, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC
